_comment: This installation's own scheduled tasks. Copy to agent/local/tasks.json (gitignored). lib/registry.cjs merges it with system/tasks.json: an entry with a new `name` is added, an entry whose `name` is a kernel task overrides only the fields it lists (so { "name": "hum-review", "paused": true } pauses a kernel task). `edva tasks pause|resume` and `edva doctor --repair` write here, never to the kernel file. The same merge applies to agent/local/services.json, agent/local/job-routing.json (key: jobs.<job>) and agent/local/chrome-jobs.json.

tasks.name: weekly-report
tasks.description: Summarize last week's calendar and closed tasks. Playbook: agent/ops-agent/jobs/_ext/weekly-report.md.
